principles: Typed content only: a piece of knowledge is represented only when it is expressed by typed entities, predicates and enumerated qualifiers. A free-text field (label, note, quote) never counts as representation; labels exist for human reading only.
Every assertion cites support (a passage of a source) and keeps the source's own status label verbatim.
Category is an entity type, never the key of knowledge. Need, situation, cause, strategy, capability, mechanism, property, method and context are category-independent.
Necessity is not sufficiency: a capability required by a strategy is a necessary condition; an artefact realises a strategy only when every requirement group is met.
Consultation is bidirectional, validity is not: every predicate can be read in both directions, but the inference rules decide separately which conclusions each direction licenses.

No total order of knowledge: the nature of a claim, the strength and independence of its evidence, its specificity and applicability, its conditions and its review state are separate dimensions. Conclusions carry each dimension; no 'minimum' collapses them.

Identity is not similarity: an alias is a surface expression of the SAME entity with the SAME meaning. Different meanings are different entities, related (if at all) by typed predicates, never by aliases.
Absence is explicit (gap), never filled by similarity.

dimension.meaning: an outcome or quality dimension of the world or of use, without direction (indoor humidity, noise exposure, food crispness, running cost). QK aspects are dimensions.
dimension.identity: the dimension itself; 'noise' and 'sound quality' are distinct dimensions

need.meaning: a desired change or state on a dimension.
need.identity: (dimension, direction) for a general need; (general need, contexts) for a contextual need. 'Less noise' and 'more sound' share no identity.

situation.meaning: what a user is in or reports.

fields.observable: dimension id or cause id it is observed on, or null

situation.identity: (kind, observable, locus); an appliance-scoped symptom ('my kettle scales') and a household state ('hard water at home') are distinct situations

cause.meaning: a physical state, process, behaviour or defect that brings about situations.
cause.identity: the state or process; a possible cause of a symptom is not a separate entity (possibility is a qualifier of the indicates/produces assertion)

strategy.meaning: an action that changes a cause or a situation, or serves a need.

fields.kind: behavioural | building_or_installation | maintenance | use_change | service | acquire_artefact
fields.target: entity id acted on or null

strategy.identity: (kind, action, target); conditions are never part of identity

capability.meaning: something an artefact or system can do (remove water vapour from air, capture airborne particles, exhaust air outdoors).
capability.identity: the function, category-independent; its LEVEL is never part of the capability (a level is a threshold on a property)

mechanism.meaning: the physical principle by which a capability or strategy acts.

component.meaning: a physical part or feature (HEPA filter, heat pump, inlet hose). Presence of a component never establishes the level of a capability.

fields.registryId: CATEGORY_REGISTRY250 id or null for an untaught family

subtype.meaning: a kind within a family (compressor dehumidifier, countertop dishwasher).

product.identity: exact keys only; never merged on names

property.meaning: a measurable quantity or a judged quality.

fields.judges: property id of the quantity a judgement concerns, or null
fields.definingConditions: context axis ids whose value must be stated for a value to be interpretable/comparable
fields.influencingConditions: context axis ids that change the value

property.identity: PD/QK id; a judgement and the quantity it concerns are distinct properties

context.meaning: a condition of use or of the user, as an axis and a value.

fields.axis: QK condition axis id, PD dimension id, use-context id, or typed context id
fields.value: value object or enumerated state or null

observation.meaning: a reported value or outcome about an artefact.

fields.statistic: single | typical | range | mean | min | max

observation.identity: row identity of the evidence table it comes from

source.meaning: a document or body that states something.

fields.role: owner_research_package | standard | regulation | independent_test_publisher | publisher_editorial | manufacturer | retailer | user_report | assistant

passage.meaning: a located part of a source (section, table, row, column, line).

value.unit: unit id (QK unit) or null when the source gives none (never assumed)

condition.ref: context id | threshold | strategy id (prerequisite only)

fields.subject: entity id
fields.asserted: affirmed | denied (negation: the source says the relation does NOT hold)
fields.modality: possible | typical | necessary | sufficient | necessary_and_sufficient | null (only where the predicate admits it)
fields.effect: increases | decreases | removes | prevents | no_effect | null
fields.scope: {level: general | category | subtype | product | variant, refs: [entity ids], contexts: [context ids]}
fields.note: free text for humans; NEVER counts as representation

claimNature.meaning: WHAT KIND of claim it is. Unordered: no nature outranks another in general.

fields.sourceLabel: the source's own status label verbatim (e.g. PROPOSED_NOT_TESTED) or null
fields.labelClass: tested | source_backed | method_reference | proposed_not_tested | synthetic | hypothesis | unlabelled

evidence.meaning: HOW WELL the claim is supported and by whom.

specificity.meaning: WHAT the claim is about; equals scope.level, with unit_tested for a single tested unit.

applicability.meaning: WHERE it holds: a result measured under some conditions transfers to others only when the conditions are comparable.

review.meaning: WHAT HAS BEEN CHECKED, by whom. Claude review is never independent.

capabilityAttribution.meaning: whether some source asserts the artefact has the capability, and with what nature

efficacy.meaning: demonstrated only by a measured result about THIS artefact (or an artefact the claim's scope covers by necessary inheritance) under conditions comparable to the user's; a principle, guidance or a result about another artefact or condition never demonstrates

cause.meaning: a cause inferred from a symptom is only possible until a user fact or observation confirms it

direction.meaning: category_to_need_consultation lists needs for which the artefact provides at least one necessary capability (not a claim that it serves them); validated only when realisation holds

changesFromV1.change: requires_function -> requires_capability with conjunctive requirement groups and optional level thresholds; has_capability carries modality (every member / most / some); I3 replaced by a rule that needs every group met, by the artefact itself or by necessary inheritance
changesFromV1.why: owner point 1: a necessary capability is not a sufficient solution; v1 I3 concluded a candidate from one shared function

changesFromV1.change: inverse traversal split into consultation (category_to_need_consultation) and validated service (category_to_need_validated, only when the forward realisation holds)
changesFromV1.why: owner point 1: bidirectional consultation, asymmetric validity

changesFromV1.change: epistemic 'kind' total order and the 'minimum along the path' rule removed; five separate dimensions (claimNature, evidence, specificity, applicability, review); conclusions carry separate labels (capabilityAttribution, realisation, efficacy, suitability)
changesFromV1.why: owner point 2: a physical law does not prove a product's performance; a reliable measurement may not transfer

changesFromV1.change: entity type 'dimension' added; need identity = (dimension, direction); contextual need = general need + contexts as an entity
changesFromV1.why: owner point 3: general vs contextual needs; opposite needs on one dimension (P-15) must not share identity

changesFromV1.change: entity types subtype, product, variant separated from category; component added with 'enables' (presence never establishes level)
changesFromV1.why: owner point 3: categories, subtypes, products and variants; existing product-rules prohibition of deriving performance from presence

changesFromV1.change: 'asserted' (affirmed/denied) separated from 'effect' (increases/decreases/...); not_sufficient_for and not_substitute_for expressed as denials of sufficiency / substitution rather than separate predicates
changesFromV1.why: owner point 3: positive vs negative effects distinct from negation; one way to say one thing

changesFromV1.change: possible vs confirmed cause: indicates/produces carry modality; a cause reached from a symptom is a possible cause in reasoning until a user fact confirms it

changesFromV1.why: dependencies (depends_on 202, increases 35, decreases 50 store statements; PD influencing conditions) had no predicate in v1; needed to express measurement-condition dependence (F9)

changesFromV1.change: distinct_from added; aliases restricted to surface expressions of the same meaning
changesFromV1.why: owner point 3: no semantic differences resolved by aliases

changesFromV1.change: valid_under removed: applicability is a condition on the assertion it limits (one way to say it)
changesFromV1.why: v1 had two ways to state applicability

changesFromV1.change: conditions carry logic (all/any), kind (applicability, prerequisite, exclusion, measurement_condition) and force (essential/modifiable/nonessential)
changesFromV1.why: owner point 1: conjunctive conditions and essential requirements

forbiddenInferences.statement: An artefact having ONE capability a strategy requires does not make it a solution when another requirement group is unmet.
Category -> need: an artefact providing a necessary capability of a strategy that addresses a need does not 'serve' that need.
A physical principle or mechanism explanation does not demonstrate the efficacy of a particular artefact.
A measured result about one product or unit does not demonstrate efficacy for its category or another product; category-level guidance does not demonstrate a product's performance.
A cause indicated by a symptom is not an established cause of the user's situation.
A denied relation never supports the positive conclusion.
Contradictory assertions with overlapping scope and conditions are never resolved by picking one; the conclusion is withheld and the conflict reported.
Semantically distinct entities (opposite directions, general vs contextual, appliance-scoped vs household) are never merged as aliases.
A result measured under some conditions is not applicable under non-comparable conditions.
Presence of a component does not establish the level or effectiveness of a capability.
A hypothesis or unreviewed, PROPOSED_NOT_TESTED or synthetic claim never yields more than a hypothesised conclusion.
A capability that only some members of a category have is not attributed to a member without member-level support.
